Not world class
Jan 2026 • Friends
They have a great cocktail program. The ex-signature drink with popcorn flavor was great.

Their service has flare and presentation is top notch. The bar staff are particular of their craft. 

Bar has an active social media presence. This is the bar to be seen at. Crowd is on the younger side.

Disappointed with the bar staff. Not world class. Part of a bar staff role is to help customers have a good time. Service was transactional. They really should not have seating at the bar - just make it a service bar. 

Having gone to world class bars - my expectations were high. This did not meet it. Left after fee drink. We wanted to stay longer being our last evening in Hanoi. Disappointed.
